_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Hero of Gavel#000.src: Find out what's happening in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#001.src: Hmm.. I might have just enough for one tier {~}... Why are you standing there?
The Hero of Gavel#001.dst: Hmm.. {~}. kademe için ancak yetecek kadar param olabilir... Sen niye dikiliyorsun orada?
The Hero of Gavel#001.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#002.src: What all these people are here for? Don't tell me you don't know about the Siegfried contest.
The Hero of Gavel#002.dst: Bu kalabalık ne için mi burada? Bana Siegfried yarışmasını bilmediğini söyleme.
The Hero of Gavel#002.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#003.src: Are you SERIOUS?! It's the biggest thing happening since the last contest last month!
The Hero of Gavel#003.dst: CİDDİ MİSİN?! Geçen ayki yarışmadan beri olan en büyük olay bu!
The Hero of Gavel#003.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#004.src: Whoever wins the big scavenger hunt gets to go on an adventure with Siegfried himself.
The Hero of Gavel#004.dst: Büyük hazine avını kazanan, bizzat Siegfried'le maceraya çıkıyor.
The Hero of Gavel#004.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#005.src: This year, I think I even have a good chance to win!
The Hero of Gavel#005.dst: Bu yıl kazanma şansım bile var bence!
The Hero of Gavel#005.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#006.src: Huh? Oh, you want this ticket? No way, this one's mine. Go get your own at that little shop.
The Hero of Gavel#006.dst: Ha? Bu bileti mi istiyorsun? Olmaz, bu benim. Git kendininkini şu küçük dükkândan al.
The Hero of Gavel#006.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#007.src: Hey, that's the mug I dropped!
The Hero of Gavel#007.speaker: Siegfried Fan 1

The Hero of Gavel#011.src: How can I win an adventure now?
The Hero of Gavel#011.speaker: Siegfried Fan 2

The Hero of Gavel#012.src: Get a Siegfried Scavenger Hunt ticket in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#012.dst: {p} merkezinden bir Siegfried Hazine Avı bileti al: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#013.src: Tickets for sale! You! Would you like to join the great Siegfried Scavenger Hunt?
The Hero of Gavel#013.dst: Biletler satışta! Sen! Büyük Siegfried Hazine Avı'na katılmak ister misin?
The Hero of Gavel#013.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#014.src: Entry is completely free, and if you win, you'll get to adventure with Siegfried himself!
The Hero of Gavel#014.dst: Katılım tamamen ücretsiz, kazanırsan bizzat Siegfried'le maceraya çıkacaksın!
The Hero of Gavel#014.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#015.src: You're interested? Great! Here, it's all quite simple.
The Hero of Gavel#015.dst: İlgileniyor musun? Harika! Al, gayet basit.
The Hero of Gavel#015.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#016.src: The ticket shows what items you need to find. It's split into three tiers.
The Hero of Gavel#016.dst: Bilette bulman gereken eşyalar yazıyor. Üç kademeye ayrılıyor.
The Hero of Gavel#016.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#017.src: The first two, they're for the common folk. But if you REALLY want to win, you need a tier {~} item.
The Hero of Gavel#017.dst: İlk ikisi sıradan halk için. Ama GERÇEKTEN kazanmak istiyorsan {~}. kademeden bir eşya lazım.
The Hero of Gavel#017.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#018.src: Heh, you can even bring all three and you're practically guaranteed to win!
The Hero of Gavel#018.dst: Heh, üçünü birden getirirsen kazanman neredeyse garanti!
The Hero of Gavel#018.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#019.src: Here, take the ticket. Come back with your items and you'll be entered into the draw.
The Hero of Gavel#019.dst: Al, bilet senin. Eşyalarınla geri gel, seni çekilişe yazayım.
The Hero of Gavel#019.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#020.src: Bring all three limited Siegfried Collection items to the merchant in {p} Center at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#020.dst: Üç sınırlı Siegfried Koleksiyonu eşyasının hepsini {p} merkezindeki tüccara götür: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#021.src: You’re back! Let me see your items.
The Hero of Gavel#021.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#022.src: This… Wow, all of them? Let me take a look at these…
The Hero of Gavel#022.dst: Bu… Vay, hepsi mi? Bir bakayım şunlara…
The Hero of Gavel#022.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#023.src: They’re all authentic! You must be ri-I mean, you must be a huge fan of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#023.dst: Hepsi orijinal! Sen zengin ol- yani, Siegfried'in büyük bir hayranı olmalısın!
The Hero of Gavel#023.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#025.src: Okay, I’ve entered you into the draw. The event’s taking place at the Golden Eagle Theatre.
The Hero of Gavel#025.dst: Tamam, seni çekilişe yazdım. Etkinlik Golden Eagle Theatre'da yapılacak.
The Hero of Gavel#025.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#026.src: Just turn toward the bank and follow the signs, the winner will be selected when everyone gets there.
The Hero of Gavel#026.dst: Bankaya doğru dön ve tabelaları takip et, herkes gelince kazanan seçilecek.
The Hero of Gavel#026.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#027.src: Go to the Golden Eagle Theatre behind the Bank in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the winners to be announced.
The Hero of Gavel#027.dst: Kazananların açıklanması için {p} bankasının arkasındaki Golden Eagle Theatre'a git: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#028.src: Welcome, welcome everyone! We’re only waiting on a few more people before we begin.
The Hero of Gavel#028.dst: Hoş geldiniz, hoş geldiniz! Başlamadan önce birkaç kişiyi daha bekliyoruz.
The Hero of Gavel#028.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#029.src: Ah, there we go! I believe we’re all set now.
The Hero of Gavel#029.dst: Ah, işte geldiler! Sanırım artık hazırız.
The Hero of Gavel#029.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#030.src: Welcome everyone, to the monthly SIEGFRIED FESTIVAL SCAVENGER HUNT!
The Hero of Gavel#030.dst: Herkes hoş geldi, aylık SIEGFRIED FESTİVALİ HAZİNE AVI'NA!
The Hero of Gavel#030.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#031.src: Today, we are once again celebrating the heroic deeds of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#031.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#032.src: All of you, my fellow gavellians, have adventured far and wide to gather rare items across the province.
The Hero of Gavel#032.dst: Siz, sevgili Gavelli dostlarım, eyaletin dört bir yanında nadir eşyalar toplamak için uzun yollar katettiniz.
The Hero of Gavel#032.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#033.src: And yet, I cannot announce the winner…
The Hero of Gavel#033.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#043.src: Thank you all for participating in this fantastic scavenger hunt around Gavel! Siegfried: The winner of this hunt will have the privilege of going on a once-in-a-lifetime, fully authentic, adventure with me!
The Hero of Gavel#043.dst: Gavel'daki bu harika hazine avına katılan herkese teşekkürler! Siegfried: Bu avın galibi, benimle hayatında bir kez yaşanacak, tamamen gerçek bir maceraya çıkma ayrıcalığına sahip olacak!
The Hero of Gavel#043.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#044.src: Now, without further ado: I shall announce the winner!
The Hero of Gavel#044.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#047.src: I better win, I bought his mug!
The Hero of Gavel#047.speaker: Siegfried Fan

The Hero of Gavel#051.src: {u}, please head to the backstage area to my right for your adventure. Thank you everyone!!
The Hero of Gavel#051.dst: {u}, maceran için lütfen sağımdaki kulise geç. Herkese teşekkürler!!
The Hero of Gavel#051.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#052.src: Meet Siegfried backstage in the Golden Eagle Theatre to go on your adventure!
The Hero of Gavel#052.dst: Maceraya çıkmak için Golden Eagle Theatre'ın kulisinde Siegfried'le buluş!

The Hero of Gavel#053.src: Welcome ! Congratulations on winning the scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#053.dst: Hoş geldin ! Hazine avını kazandığın için tebrikler!
The Hero of Gavel#053.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#054.src: Today, you’ll be going with me on one of my glorious adventures.
The Hero of Gavel#054.dst: Bugün benimle şanlı maceralarımdan birine çıkacaksın.
The Hero of Gavel#054.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#055.src: And to get there, we’ll ride in the great Siegfried Airship!
The Hero of Gavel#055.dst: Oraya gitmek için de büyük Siegfried Zeplini'ne bineceğiz!
The Hero of Gavel#055.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#056.src: It’s up at the airship docks – I’ll teleport us there!
The Hero of Gavel#056.dst: Zeplin limanında duruyor, bizi oraya ışınlayacağım!
The Hero of Gavel#056.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#057.src: (translated: Gavellian) MAGICAL MAGICKY MAGIC MAGICSPELL. Teleport!
The Hero of Gavel#057.dst: (çeviri: Gavelce) BÜYÜLÜ BÜYÜCÜK BÜYÜ BÜYÜSÖZ. Işınlan!
The Hero of Gavel#057.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#059.src: Travel with Siegfried on his airship at the {p} airship docks at [{~}, {~},-{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#059.dst: {p} zeplin limanında Siegfried'in zepliniyle yolculuk et: [{~}, {~},-{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#060.src: Here, follow me onto the airship!
The Hero of Gavel#060.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#062.src: Impressed by my piloting skills? Dodging these islands isn’t a challenge at all for the mighty Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#062.dst: Pilotluk becerilerime hayran mı kaldın? Bu adalardan kaçmak yüce Siegfried için hiç zor değil!
The Hero of Gavel#062.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#063.src: I rode an airship much like this one when I saved {p} from the dragon.
The Hero of Gavel#063.dst: {p} bölgesini ejderhadan kurtardığımda da buna çok benzeyen bir zeplin kullanmıştım.
The Hero of Gavel#063.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#064.src: Right now we’re heading to a cave on the far east of the region.
The Hero of Gavel#064.dst: Şu an bölgenin en doğusundaki bir mağaraya gidiyoruz.
The Hero of Gavel#064.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#065.src: We’ll have to navigate its treacherous corridors and defeat terrible beasts to get to the treasure at the end.
The Hero of Gavel#065.dst: Sondaki hazineye ulaşmak için hain koridorlarından geçip korkunç canavarları yenmemiz gerekecek.
The Hero of Gavel#065.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#066.src: Why don’t you go get my map from the upper level of the airship, and we’ll get ready for our adventure.
The Hero of Gavel#066.dst: Zeplinin üst katından haritamı getirsene, biz de maceraya hazırlanalım.
The Hero of Gavel#066.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#067.src: How much lon- Oh, you brought the map!
The Hero of Gavel#067.dst: Daha ne kadar- Aa, haritayı getirmişsin!
The Hero of Gavel#067.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#068.src: We’ll need to use this map to navigate the dangerous cave we’re going to.
The Hero of Gavel#068.dst: Gideceğimiz tehlikeli mağarada yolumuzu bu haritayla bulacağız.
The Hero of Gavel#068.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#069.src: How did I get this? Well-er- I always prepare before my adventures!
The Hero of Gavel#069.dst: Bunu nereden mi buldum? Şey-ee- Maceralarımdan önce hep hazırlık yaparım!
The Hero of Gavel#069.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#070.src: Anyway, we’re about to land now – be careful not to fall off!
The Hero of Gavel#070.dst: Neyse, inmek üzereyiz, dikkat et de düşme!
The Hero of Gavel#070.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#071.src: Enter the perilous cave on the eastern edge of the {p} with Siegfried at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#071.dst: Siegfried'le birlikte {p} bölgesinin doğu ucundaki tehlikeli mağaraya gir: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#072.src: Here we are, the great Cave of Treasure-Hoarding Evil Creatures!
The Hero of Gavel#072.dst: İşte geldik, Hazine İstifleyen Kötü Yaratıklar'ın büyük Mağarası!
The Hero of Gavel#072.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#073.src: Speak to me when you’re fully prepared for this dangerous adventure.
The Hero of Gavel#073.dst: Bu tehlikeli maceraya tamamen hazır olduğunda benimle konuş.
The Hero of Gavel#073.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#074.src: This cave is exceedingly dangerous, so make sure to follow my instructions.
The Hero of Gavel#074.dst: Bu mağara son derece tehlikeli, o yüzden talimatlarıma uymaya dikkat et.
The Hero of Gavel#074.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#075.src: I’ve got decades of experience bravely adventuring in these caves, so I know what I’m doing.
The Hero of Gavel#075.dst: Bu mağaralarda yılların cesur maceracılık tecrübesi var bende, ne yaptığımı biliyorum.
The Hero of Gavel#075.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#077.src: Follow Siegfried through the cave on the eastern edge of the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#077.dst: {p} bölgesinin doğu ucundaki mağarada Siegfried'i takip et: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#078.src: You sure took your time getting here! No matter.
The Hero of Gavel#078.dst: Buraya gelmen epey sürdü! Neyse, önemli değil.
The Hero of Gavel#078.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#079.src: I adventure in caves such as these often to get rid of the evil beasts dwelling within.
The Hero of Gavel#079.dst: İçinde yaşayan kötü canavarlardan kurtulmak için böyle mağaralarda sık sık maceraya atılırım.
The Hero of Gavel#079.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#080.src: If it wasn’t for me defeating them before they could even--
The Hero of Gavel#080.dst: Onlar daha harekete geçemeden ben yenmeseydim--
The Hero of Gavel#080.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#081.src: Woah, stop! This might look like a harmless decoration, but it’s a trap!
The Hero of Gavel#081.dst: Dur, dur! Bu zararsız bir süs gibi görünebilir ama bir tuzak!
The Hero of Gavel#081.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#082.src: Stay behind me, I’ll open it with my magic spell. (translated: Gavellian) OPEN!
The Hero of Gavel#082.dst: Arkamda dur, büyümle açacağım. (çeviri: Gavelce) AÇIL!
The Hero of Gavel#082.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#083.src: Aha! I’ll protect you from the guardian, you deal with the rat!
The Hero of Gavel#083.dst: Aha! Seni bekçiden ben korurum, sen fareyi hallet!
The Hero of Gavel#083.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#085.src: Ow- I mean, hah! That was easier than swatting a fly for the mighty Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#085.dst: Ay- yani, hah! Yüce Siegfried için sinek kovalamaktan bile kolaydı!
The Hero of Gavel#085.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#086.src: Seems like we’re done here! That must have been a very difficult fight for you.
The Hero of Gavel#086.dst: Görünüşe göre burada işimiz bitti! Senin için çok zorlu bir dövüş olmuştur.
The Hero of Gavel#086.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#087.src: The caves I adventure in are filled with terrifying beasts similar to those.
The Hero of Gavel#087.dst: Maceraya atıldığım mağaralar bunlara benzer korkunç canavarlarla dolu.
The Hero of Gavel#087.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#088.src: WAIT! Don’t move, that boulder is about to fall!
The Hero of Gavel#088.dst: DUR! Kıpırdama, o kaya düşmek üzere!
The Hero of Gavel#088.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#089.src: Wow, that was close! Of course, I saw that coming and had no risk at all.
The Hero of Gavel#089.dst: Vay, kıl payı! Tabii ben bunu önceden gördüm, hiç risk yoktu.
The Hero of Gavel#089.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#090.src: You might say that we can’t go further, as it’s blocking our way. But I can fix that!
The Hero of Gavel#090.dst: Yolumuzu kapattığı için daha ileri gidemeyiz diyebilirsin. Ama ben bunu hallederim!
The Hero of Gavel#090.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#091.src: And no more boulder! Only one as powerful as I can do that.
The Hero of Gavel#091.dst: Ve kaya yok! Bunu ancak benim kadar güçlü biri yapabilir.
The Hero of Gavel#091.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#092.src: All we must do now is cross a perilous bridge over the Endless Chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#092.dst: Şimdi tek yapmamız gereken Sonsuz Uçurum'un üzerindeki tehlikeli köprüden geçmek.
The Hero of Gavel#092.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#093.src: Aa, why did- Woah, careful! It looks like the bridge fell.
The Hero of Gavel#093.dst: Aa, niye- Dikkat! Köprü çökmüş galiba.
The Hero of Gavel#093.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#094.src: But this is not such an obstacle as you might think, for I can, uh, jump over this chasm!
The Hero of Gavel#094.dst: Ama bu sandığın kadar büyük bir engel değil, çünkü ben, ıı, bu uçurumun üstünden atlayabilirim!
The Hero of Gavel#094.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#099.src: Jump after Siegfried into the pit at the end of the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#099.dst: Mağaranın sonundaki çukura Siegfried'in peşinden atla.

The Hero of Gavel#100.src: Find a way to wake Siegfried.

The Hero of Gavel#102.src: Aaaaggggh my LEGS MY LEGS AAAGGH SO COLD!
The Hero of Gavel#102.dst: Aaaaggggh BACAKLARIM BACAKLARIM AAAGGH ÇOK SOĞUK!
The Hero of Gavel#102.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#104.src: Why couldn’t I THINK when I signed that STUPID CONTRACT that I’d end up here!?
The Hero of Gavel#104.dst: O APTAL SÖZLEŞMEYİ imzalarken neden buraya düşeceğimi DÜŞÜNEMEDİM ki!?
The Hero of Gavel#104.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#106.src: They aren’t gonna come rescue us, you know. We’re on our own.
The Hero of Gavel#106.dst: Bizi kurtarmaya gelmeyecekler, biliyorsun. Başımızın çaresine kendimiz bakacağız.
The Hero of Gavel#106.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#107.src: Why are you so calm? DON’T YOU SEE?!
The Hero of Gavel#107.dst: Nasıl bu kadar sakinsin? GÖRMÜYOR MUSUN?!
The Hero of Gavel#107.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#108.src: WE’RE ON OUR OWN! This is REAL now! No coming back after ‘dying’, no more obvious traps, no more Siegfried. If I die here, I DIE! No coming back!
The Hero of Gavel#108.dst: YAPAYALNIZIZ! Bu artık GERÇEK! 'Öldükten' sonra geri dönmek yok, göstermelik tuzaklar yok, Siegfried yok. Burada ölürsem ÖLÜRÜM! Dönüşü yok!
The Hero of Gavel#108.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#109.src: I.. I can’t do this. We’ll just starve here, in this cave… where nobody will ever find our bodies.
The Hero of Gavel#109.dst: Ben.. ben bunu yapamam. Burada, bu mağarada açlıktan öleceğiz… cesetlerimizi kimse bulamayacak.
The Hero of Gavel#109.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#110.src: Stop looking at me! You figure out how to get us out of here, I’m just a worthless actor! Tell me if you find anything, I- I need a moment alone.
The Hero of Gavel#110.dst: Bakma bana öyle! Buradan nasıl çıkacağımızı sen bul, ben değersiz bir aktörüm sadece! Bir şey bulursan söyle, ben- biraz yalnız kalmam lazım.
The Hero of Gavel#110.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#111.src: You found something? Ok. I’ll… follow you then.
The Hero of Gavel#111.dst: Bir şey mi buldun? Tamam. O zaman… seni takip ederim.
The Hero of Gavel#111.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#112.src: WHAT WAS THAT SOUND?! A- are you sure we should go into there?
The Hero of Gavel#112.dst: O SES DE NEYDİ?! G- gerçekten oraya girmeli miyiz?
The Hero of Gavel#112.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#113.src: MY ARM! IT HIT MY ARM!
The Hero of Gavel#113.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#114.src: … I think I can manage.. OW!
The Hero of Gavel#114.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#115.src: Venture deeper into the cave with Siegfried.

The Hero of Gavel#116.src: You.. You got us out of there!
The Hero of Gavel#116.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#117.src: I didn’t think we’d ever find a way out of there…
The Hero of Gavel#117.dst: Oradan bir çıkış bulabileceğimizi hiç sanmıyordum…
The Hero of Gavel#117.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#118.src: … Well, I guess we should keep going. M- Maybe there’s a way out?
The Hero of Gavel#118.dst: … Eh, sanırım devam etmeliyiz. B- Belki bir çıkış vardır?
The Hero of Gavel#118.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#119.src: L- Look! There’s plants and light up ahead! A WAY OUT!
The Hero of Gavel#119.dst: B- Bak! İleride bitkiler ve ışık var! BİR ÇIKIŞ!
The Hero of Gavel#119.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#122.src: Rescue Siegfried from the trap OR leave him there.
The Hero of Gavel#122.dst: Siegfried'i tuzaktan kurtar YA DA onu orada bırak.

The Hero of Gavel#123.src: W- What just happened?! I’m trapped in here!
The Hero of Gavel#123.dst: N- Ne oldu?! Burada mahsur kaldım!
The Hero of Gavel#123.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#124.src: … It’s… some sort of trap. I can feel the ground heating up!!
The Hero of Gavel#124.dst: … Bu… bir çeşit tuzak. Zeminin ısındığını hissediyorum!!
The Hero of Gavel#124.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#125.src: T-That was terrifying… Y-you saved my life. Thank you … I wasn’t prepared for real danger like this.
The Hero of Gavel#125.dst: Ç-Çok korkunçtu… H-hayatımı kurtardın. Teşekkür ederim … Böyle gerçek bir tehlikeye hazırlıklı değildim.
The Hero of Gavel#125.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#126.src: Rest before continuing through the cave.

The Hero of Gavel#127.src: …What? Houses, and a well? All the way down here?
The Hero of Gavel#127.dst: …Ne? Evler ve bir kuyu mu? Bu kadar aşağıda?
The Hero of Gavel#127.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#128.src: It’s… empty. And the houses sure don’t look like anyone’s lived here for.. centuries.
The Hero of Gavel#128.dst: Burası… boş. Evlere bakılırsa burada yüzyıllardır.. kimse yaşamamış.
The Hero of Gavel#128.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#129.src: OW! MY LEGS! And my arms, too! E- Everything hurts so much.. I need to sit down. I think I turned my arm the wrong way.
The Hero of Gavel#129.dst: AY! BACAKLARIM! Kollarım da! H- Her yerim çok acıyor.. Oturmam lazım. Sanırım kolumu ters çevirdim.
The Hero of Gavel#129.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#130.src: I’ll just.. rest here a bit. W- would you mind taking a look around for something we can eat? I can.. hardly move.
The Hero of Gavel#130.dst: Ben biraz.. burada dinleneyim. Y- yiyecek bir şeyler için etrafa bakar mısın? Ben.. kıpırdayamıyorum bile.
The Hero of Gavel#130.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#131.src: … Was this a sandwich at some point?
The Hero of Gavel#131.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#132.src: It barely has any resemblance to one.
The Hero of Gavel#132.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#133.src: Well… I doubt there’s anything better around here. I- I’ll take it.
The Hero of Gavel#133.dst: Eh… Buralarda daha iyisi yoktur herhalde. B- Bunu alayım.
The Hero of Gavel#133.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#134.src: OW!! I think I broke my teeth! This is like eating stone!
The Hero of Gavel#134.dst: AY!! Sanırım dişlerimi kırdım! Taş yemek gibi!
The Hero of Gavel#134.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#135.src: … I th-ow-ink I’m ready to- ow- move on. Let’s get go-oow-ing.
The Hero of Gavel#135.dst: … Sanı-ay-rım devam etmeye- ay- hazırım. Hadi gide-ayy-lim.
The Hero of Gavel#135.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#136.src: ... Is this the food you found?
The Hero of Gavel#136.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#137.src: I guess it's... the best that could be found here. You say you cooked it yourself?
The Hero of Gavel#137.dst: Herhalde... burada bulunabilecek en iyisi bu. Kendin mi pişirdin dedin?
The Hero of Gavel#137.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#138.src: I'll give it a try, then. Doubt there's anything better around here.
The Hero of Gavel#138.dst: O zaman bir deneyeyim. Buralarda daha iyisi yoktur zaten.
The Hero of Gavel#138.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#140.src: Thank you, {u}! I feel much better. I can head deeper as soon as you're ready.
The Hero of Gavel#140.dst: Teşekkürler, {u}! Çok daha iyi hissediyorum. Sen hazır olduğunda derinlere inebilirim.
The Hero of Gavel#140.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#142.src: I guess... I'll eat it, if it's the only food around.
The Hero of Gavel#142.dst: Herhalde... buralardaki tek yiyecek buysa yerim.
The Hero of Gavel#142.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#143.src: Let's see... How do i even eat these?
The Hero of Gavel#143.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#146.src: You know… my name is actually Gurix.
The Hero of Gavel#146.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#147.src: Sound extremely Corkian, I know. They made me use Siegfried because it sounds less foreign, I suppose.
The Hero of Gavel#147.dst: Çok Corkuslu duruyor, biliyorum. Daha az yabancı geldiği için Siegfried adını kullandırdılar herhalde.
The Hero of Gavel#147.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#149.src: OW! {u}, I think this web is poisoned! Quick, get me out with one of your spells!
The Hero of Gavel#149.dst: AY! {u}, bu ağ zehirli galiba! Çabuk, bir büyünle çıkar beni!
The Hero of Gavel#149.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#150.src: Thank you . I’ll.. I’ll follow you from now on. Clearly you’re more prepared than I am.
The Hero of Gavel#150.dst: Teşekkürler . Ben.. Bundan sonra seni takip edeceğim. Belli ki benden daha hazırlıklısın.
The Hero of Gavel#150.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#151.src: Find your way through the spider burrows.

The Hero of Gavel#152.src: {u}? I think that giant web there is being held up by the platforms on the walls.
The Hero of Gavel#152.dst: {u}? Sanırım şuradaki dev ağı duvarlardaki platformlar tutuyor.
The Hero of Gavel#152.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#153.src: I think… Maybe you can cut them down? I’ll stay here, I think it’s the safest place. I’ll call for you if a spider webs me again.
The Hero of Gavel#153.dst: Bence… Belki onları kesebilirsin? Ben burada kalayım, en güvenli yer burası galiba. Bir örümcek beni yine ağa sararsa seslenirim.
The Hero of Gavel#153.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#154.src: You did it! The web fell!
The Hero of Gavel#154.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#155.src: Let’s head onwards, I don’t want to deal with any more spiders.
The Hero of Gavel#155.dst: Hadi ilerleyelim, daha fazla örümcekle uğraşmak istemiyorum.
The Hero of Gavel#155.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#157.src: Hey, wait up! Thanks for saving me there.
The Hero of Gavel#157.dst: Hey, bekle! Orada beni kurtardığın için sağ ol.
The Hero of Gavel#157.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#158.src: Woah... This is enormous! Who knows what this used to be?
The Hero of Gavel#158.dst: Vay... Burası devasa! Eskiden ne olduğunu kim bilir?
The Hero of Gavel#158.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#159.src: The path seems to be across those yellow shards, maybe we can reach them?
The Hero of Gavel#159.dst: Yol şu sarı kristallerin karşısında gibi, onlara ulaşabilir miyiz?
The Hero of Gavel#159.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#160.src: Find a way to escape through the skylight at the end of the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#160.dst: Mağaranın sonundaki tavan penceresinden kaçmanın bir yolunu bul.

The Hero of Gavel#161.src: Another town? Or another part of the same one? I’m not sure..
The Hero of Gavel#161.dst: Başka bir kasaba mı? Yoksa aynısının başka bir kısmı mı? Emin değilim..
The Hero of Gavel#161.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#162.src: This one even seems to have a forge and a tailor.. It was a full, proper village!
The Hero of Gavel#162.dst: Burada demirhane ve terzi bile var gibi.. Tam teşekküllü bir köymüş!
The Hero of Gavel#162.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#164.src: {u}, look! I can see the sky from here! M- maybe there’s a way to get up!
The Hero of Gavel#164.dst: {u}, bak! Buradan gökyüzünü görebiliyorum! B- belki yukarı çıkmanın bir yolu vardır!
The Hero of Gavel#164.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#165.src: I think.. what if we can this geyser somehow? It looks dormant, but I feel like we can activate it again.
The Hero of Gavel#165.dst: Bence.. ya şu gayzeri bir şekilde kullanabilirsek? Uykuda gibi duruyor ama yeniden çalıştırabiliriz gibi geliyor.
The Hero of Gavel#165.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#166.src: You take a look around, I’ll be resting a little. I don’t think I’ve ever walked this much in my life…
The Hero of Gavel#166.dst: Sen etrafa bir bak, ben biraz dinleneceğim. Hayatımda hiç bu kadar yürüdüğümü sanmıyorum…
The Hero of Gavel#166.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#168.src: W-Wait.. that’ll be quite a long fall after we get launched up. Can you try making some safety equipment, like a parachute or some really soft boots?
The Hero of Gavel#168.dst: B-Bekle.. yukarı fırlatıldıktan sonra epey uzun bir düşüş olacak. Paraşüt ya da çok yumuşak botlar gibi bir güvenlik donanımı yapmayı deneyebilir misin?
The Hero of Gavel#168.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#169.src: You’ve already made something? Let me see.
The Hero of Gavel#169.dst: Bir şey yaptın bile mi? Göster bakayım.
The Hero of Gavel#169.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#170.src: This looks… usable? It’s something, at least.
The Hero of Gavel#170.dst: Bu… kullanılabilir gibi mi? En azından bir şey.
The Hero of Gavel#170.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#171.src: Probably the best we’ll get down here. Are you sure you don’t need anything for yourself? No? Okay.
The Hero of Gavel#171.dst: Herhalde burada elde edebileceğimizin en iyisi bu. Kendin için bir şeye ihtiyacın olmadığından emin misin? Yok mu? Peki.
The Hero of Gavel#171.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#172.src: I can’t wait to see the look on their faces when we get back. We’ve just saved the legacy of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#172.dst: Döndüğümüzde suratlarındaki ifadeyi görmek için sabırsızlanıyorum. Siegfried'in mirasını kurtardık!
The Hero of Gavel#172.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#176.src: W-we made it? …, WE DID IT! WE’RE BACK! HAHAAA! I’M ALIVE!
The Hero of Gavel#176.dst: B-başardık mı? …, BAŞARDIK! GERİ DÖNDÜK! HAHAAA! YAŞIYORUM!
The Hero of Gavel#176.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#177.src: Hello there! It is I, Siegfried, and I just stopped the threat that was this cave!
The Hero of Gavel#177.dst: Merhaba! Benim, Siegfried, ve bu mağaranın tehdidini az önce durdurdum!
The Hero of Gavel#177.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#178.src: Hah, that’s a great costume you have there! Looks just like me!
The Hero of Gavel#178.dst: Hah, harika bir kostümün var! Tıpkı bana benziyor!
The Hero of Gavel#178.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#179.dst: Ne? B- Benim yerime başkasını mı KOYDULAR?
The Hero of Gavel#179.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#180.src: Hah, don’t mind the jokester over there. He does have an impressive costume though!
The Hero of Gavel#180.dst: Hah, şuradaki şakacıya aldırma. Gerçi kostümü etkileyici!
The Hero of Gavel#180.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#181.src: W-what's going on here? You can't replace me!
The Hero of Gavel#181.dst: N-neler oluyor burada? Benim yerime başkasını koyamazsınız!
The Hero of Gavel#181.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#183.src: Look over there! Those must be fireworks to celebrate my victory!
The Hero of Gavel#183.dst: Şuraya bakın! Bunlar zaferimi kutlamak için atılan havai fişekler olmalı!
The Hero of Gavel#183.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#185.src: Well, anyways! You had a really bad fall in that cave there. I carried you out myself, you must’ve had some wild hallucinations.
The Hero of Gavel#185.dst: Neyse işte! O mağarada çok kötü düştün. Seni oradan bizzat ben taşıdım, epey tuhaf halüsinasyonlar görmüş olmalısın.
The Hero of Gavel#185.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#186.src: Even though it was your own mistake, I’ll return you the emeralds you spent on the scavenger hunt.. and some more as compensation. That'll be.. [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
The Hero of Gavel#186.dst: Kendi hatan olsa da hazine avına harcadığın zümrütleri.. bir de tazminat olarak biraz daha fazlasını sana geri vereceğim. Ediyor.. [{~} Sıvı Zümrüt]!
The Hero of Gavel#186.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#187.src: I must return to {p} for the celebration now. Perhaps we will meet again at the next scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#187.dst: Şimdi kutlama için {p} şehrine dönmeliyim. Belki bir sonraki hazine avında yine karşılaşırız!
The Hero of Gavel#187.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#188.src: Hello there, human! It is I, Siegfried! You must have just missed how I expertly ended the threat of this monster-ridden cave!
The Hero of Gavel#188.dst: Merhaba, insan! Benim, Siegfried! Canavar dolu bu mağaranın tehdidine nasıl ustalıkla son verdiğimi az farkla kaçırdın!
The Hero of Gavel#188.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#191.src: {u}, I'm glad to see you managed to get out alive. That must have been quite a fall into the chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#191.dst: {u}, sağ salim çıkabildiğine sevindim. Uçuruma düşmek epey sert olmuş olmalı.
The Hero of Gavel#191.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#192.src: Of course, I got out easily using my spells and great knowledge of caves! Well, I must be off now. Maybe we may meet again if you win the next scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#192.dst: Ben tabii büyülerim ve mağaralar hakkındaki engin bilgim sayesinde kolayca çıktım! Eh, artık gitmeliyim. Belki bir sonraki hazine avını kazanırsan yine karşılaşırız!
The Hero of Gavel#192.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#193.src: As compensation for your unfortunate accident, Siegfried will return you the emeralds spent on purchasing scavenger hunt items.
The Hero of Gavel#193.dst: Talihsiz kazanın için tazminat olarak Siegfried, hazine avı eşyalarına harcadığın zümrütleri sana geri verecek.

The Hero of Gavel#194.src: That should amount to... {~} Liquid Emeralds. We apologize for the difficulties you encountered during your adventure with Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#194.dst: Bu da... {~} Sıvı Zümrüt ediyor. Siegfried'le maceran sırasında yaşadığın zorluklar için özür dileriz!
